subject: Cannot log in after password reset
body: Since resetting my password yesterday I get 'invalid credentials' on every attempt, even with the new password from the email link. Two colleagues report the same.

subject: Invoice PDF shows wrong VAT number
body: Our July invoice lists our old VAT number. Please reissue with the updated one we submitted in June.

subject: API returns 500 on bulk export
body: POST /v2/exports with more than 5000 rows returns HTTP 500 since Monday. Smaller exports work. This blocks our nightly sync and our warehouse data is now two days stale.

subject: Feature request: dark mode in dashboard
body: Our night-shift operators would love a dark theme for the analytics dashboard. Not urgent, but it comes up in every internal survey.

subject: Data breach concern: shared report link visible without login
body: A report link shared by a colleague opens without any authentication in an incognito window. The report contains client account balances. Please advise immediately.

subject: How do I add a new user seat?
body: Answered by support: seats are managed under Settings > Team. Customer confirmed resolved.

subject: Webhook retries flooding our endpoint
body: Failed webhook deliveries are retried every 10 seconds without backoff, which triggered our rate limiter and is now causing an outage loop on our side. Can retries use exponential backoff, or can we pause deliveries?

subject: CSV import silently drops rows with accented characters
body: Importing our contact list drops every row containing names with accents (é, ü, ø). No error is shown; the rows are just missing afterwards. Looks like an encoding issue.
